headline: McKinsey is making job applicants spar with a fake AI client
summary: McKinsey will use AI client simulations for entry-level interviews. Candidates will have a 10-minute conversation with an AI. The AI aims to replicate 80% of real client scenarios.

headline: The best feature of Apple’s HomeView might be its simplicity
summary: Apple's HomeView is praised for its simple, user-friendly approach. It offers a shared, always-available household interface. The product is seen as the right fit for Apple Home.

headline: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
summary: Eight US states are suing OpenAI over ChatGPT's safety. Lawsuits allege the company harms children and misleads customers. OpenAI is accused of prioritizing profits over safety.

headline: Microsoft and Japan took down a cybercrime network behind over a billion scam messages
summary: Microsoft and Japan's police dismantled a major cybercrime network. The network was responsible for over a billion scam and phishing messages. This takedown aims to reduce widespread scam texts.

headline: Callina Liang Says She Felt 'A Lot of Pressure' After Seeing How Reddit Reacted to Her Being Cast as Chun-Li
summary: Callina Liang felt immense pressure after her Chun-Li casting. She observed negative fan reactions on Reddit. Liang discussed the scrutiny she faced for the Street Fighter role.

headline: Xbox Reportedly Surveys Users On Return to Full Exclusivity for its Games
summary: Xbox is reportedly surveying players on game exclusivity. The survey explores a potential return to full console exclusivity. Call of Duty is noted as a possible exception.

headline: The Street Fighter Cast Would Love to Make a Mortal Kombat Crossover Movie
summary: The cast of the Street Fighter movie expressed interest in a crossover. Many actors are open to a Mortal Kombat film collaboration. Discussions occurred prior to the Street Fighter movie's release.

headline: Mick Gordon On How He Helped to Make Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’s Climactic Boss Fight “Big and Bombastic”
summary: Mick Gordon details his role in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2. He focused on creating an impactful climactic boss fight. Gordon aimed for a "big and bombastic" final encounter.

headline: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
summary: Elon Musk states US dictates Starlink access limits in Ukraine. Ukraine reports improved access but still faces speed restrictions. These limits are reportedly disrupting battlefield missions.

headline: We are behind you and that will not change, PM tells Zelensky
summary: The UK Prime Minister reaffirmed unwavering support to Zelensky. Zelensky visited London to secure European allied backing. The visit follows recent tensions with Donald Trump.

headline: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
summary: Russell Brand's rape trial has officially commenced. Prosecution alleges he acted as a 'sexual predator'. Brand has pleaded not guilty to multiple charges.

headline: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
summary: Sally Rooney's books have been withdrawn from sale in the UK. The withdrawal is linked to her support for Palestine Action. Rooney is a well-known Irish novelist.
